name: xvii messenger for vk
tagline: simple and handy messenger for vk social network but with extra features
blurb: xvii is a messenger for those who want to be online on the go!
description:
xvii is a messenger for those who want to be online on the go! no feed, no stories, no walls, no likes, no clips. only messaging and features that are necessary!

extra features:

* secret chats
* custom appearance
* stealth features
* multiple accounts
* self-destructing and scheduled messages
* journal of events
* no ads, no trackers
